input.objective: Identify the exact San Francisco city agency responsible for this issue and the official reporting channel with its URL. Issue category: tree. Prefer official city government pages such as sf.gov and 311.
queries: San Francisco report street tree problem 311 Public Works urban forestry

value.title: Report a damaged or fallen tree | SF.gov
value.excerpt: San Francisco Public Works urban forestry maintains street trees. Report hanging limbs, fallen branches or tree damage. Hazardous limbs are treated as urgent.

value.title: 311 Customer Service Center | SF.gov
value.excerpt: SF 311 is the city's single point of contact for non emergency service requests. Call 311, use the web forms, or use the SF311 mobile app.
